test: B2-2 HU degeneration: research engine with the SB out before the flop action and NON-blocking, vs the vendored HU solver on the identical HU game

game.terminal: data/gto_terminal_expansion/terminals/p9_node46.json (BB and BTN arriving ranges at P9)
game.menu: M2 (50% bet, raise all-in, 1 raise/street, 0.85 all-in threshold, no donk leads)

vendored_reference: t2_cont_panel on a HU terminal file with the same two ranges, one-board panel, target 0.3% pot, max 1000 iterations
engine: t2_3way solve --fold-first SB --nonblocking SB, DCFR (1.5, 0, 2), alternating updates, full chance enumeration; run until its own exploitability <= 0.3% pot or 1000 iterations

pass_criteria_fixed_before_running.conservation_bb: |sum of both players range values - pot| <= 1e-6
pass_criteria_fixed_before_running.engine_exploitability: <= 0.30% pot (same target as the vendored solves)
pass_criteria_fixed_before_running.class_values: mean |engine - vendored| over the 169 classes <= 0.05 bb per player (storage band 0.03-0.04, solver residual 0.01-0.02 measured in J1-J3)
pass_criteria_fixed_before_running.range_values: |range EV engine - vendored| <= 0.02 bb per player (J1 fixed point vs joint: 0.011-0.019)
pass_criteria_fixed_before_running.aggregate_strategy: first BB decision (check / bet) and BTN facing a check (check / bet): |frequency difference| <= 0.05

if_fail: no node 46 solve; the failing component is isolated first
